setup.row_definition: Nine free long exterior vertical ribs, excluding the two half-rows attached to loading bars; midpoint of each straight outer face.
setup.bonded: Outer bottom face ux=uy=0; outer top face ux=0,uy=-travel. Bars remain deformable.
setup.frictionless: Both outer faces constrained in y only; one bottom-centre point ux=0 removes rigid translation. Closed-contact roller idealisation, no unilateral contact.
setup.model: Homogeneous isotropic small-strain linear elasticity, plane strain. No damage, plasticity, geometric nonlinearity, contact or buckling.
setup.independence: No peer FE predictions, Instron data or photos read before freeze.
